text:
Main derivative of immutable SourceOnly v2, following the user correction on 2026-10-13.
Finite/protocol/context/runtime/fault/ownership/QUIT gates are unchanged.
Generation fingerprint differences remain measured observations, never proof of model quality loss.
A closed fault-free run may be speed-measurement eligible while quality remains unevaluated/unqualified.
Same-input histories/full-vocabulary comparison and task scores are required for quality evaluation.
Strict bitwise CPU arithmetic fixtures remain valid and are not weakened.
Old v2 artifacts/results are immutable. This new source needs fresh Main CPU/admission qualification.
